name: @flowforge/session-format-catalog
description: FlowForge build-static Session format catalog (A17/A20) — assembles the complete adjacent v0->v1->v2 release chain (frozen physical codecs plus migrations) and the "installed current Session" restore/validation seam into one immutable `sessionFormatCatalog` (currentVersion = 2). Ported from dsh `dsh-session-format-catalog`. Depends only on @flowforge/session-format, @flowforge/session-format-v0-to-v1, and @flowforge/session-format-v1-to-v2; the installed-Session vocabulary and validation enter through an injected InstalledSessionPort (real memory implementation, no mocks).
